title: Use the Hospital as a Reject Station to Address Unsorted Totes (Tipper issue handling)
summary: If a tipper problem prevents packages/totes from being sorted, route the affected totes to the Hospital (reject station) so an operator can address them and get the associated packages back onto the system for further processing.
when_to_use: Use when the system indicates a tipper issue and packages/totes “didn’t get sorted,” and the workflow directs the affected totes to the Hospital as a reject station for operator handling so packages can return to the system.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: physically route/address the totes at the Hospital reject station so the associated packages can be put back onto the system.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator ability to address totes at the Hospital station (as described in the segment)

system_preconditions: A tipper-related condition is present such that packages/totes were not sorted (the segment describes this as “something wrong with Tipper” and that the package “didn’t get sorted”).
The affected totes/packages are directed to the Hospital (reject station) for operator handling (the segment states “ADV sent to hospital”).

visual_references.description: Training segment frame showing the Hospital-as-reject-station concept for operator handling when there is a tipper issue and packages did not get sorted.

steps.title: Identify the tipper-related unsorted condition
steps.purpose: Confirm you are responding to the specific scenario where a tipper problem prevents sorting and packages/totes must be handled via the Hospital reject station.
steps.instruction: Use the scenario described in the segment: when “something’s wrong with Tipper” and the package “didn’t get sorted,” treat the affected totes/packages as needing Hospital reject-station handling.
steps.expected_result: You have identified that the current packages/totes were not sorted due to a tipper issue (the segment ties this directly to the Hospital reject-station workflow).
steps.healthy_condition: The situation matches the segment’s described trigger: tipper issue + packages/totes not sorted.
steps.failure_condition: You proceed as if it is a tipper-related unsorted condition when the totes/packages are not actually in the described “didn’t get sorted” scenario.

actions.label: Confirm tipper issue + unsorted packages
actions.exact_action: Identify that “something’s wrong with Tipper” and the package “didn’t get sorted.”

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: “there’s something wrong with Tipper again… It didn’t get sorted”

steps.title: Route the affected totes/packages to the Hospital reject station
steps.purpose: Ensure the unsorted totes/packages are brought to the correct physical handling location described as the Hospital reject station.
steps.instruction: Follow the segment’s workflow that sends the affected totes to the Hospital: “ADV sent to hospital.” Bring the affected totes to the Hospital reject station so the operator can address them.
steps.expected_result: The affected totes/packages are at the Hospital reject station location for operator handling.
steps.healthy_condition: You can physically locate the totes at the Hospital reject station as the segment describes (“hospital is just a reject station for an operator to address those totes”).
steps.failure_condition: The totes/packages are not at the Hospital reject station when you attempt to perform the operator handling step.

actions.label: Bring totes to Hospital reject station
actions.exact_action: Route/bring the affected totes to the “hospital” described as “just a reject station for an operator to address those totes.”

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: “ADV sent to hospital… the hospital is just a reject station for an operator to address those totes”

steps.title: Address the totes at the Hospital reject station
steps.purpose: Perform the operator handling at the Hospital so the associated packages can be returned to the system.
steps.instruction: At the Hospital reject station, perform the operator handling described in the segment: “takes the tote goes there and operate there something like that.”
steps.expected_result: The operator has addressed the totes at the Hospital reject station as part of the reject-station handling workflow.
steps.healthy_condition: The handling is performed at the Hospital reject station (the segment’s defined operator action location) for totes that were not sorted due to the tipper issue.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot address the totes at the Hospital reject station as described in the segment (e.g., totes cannot be handled there).

actions.label: Operate on totes at Hospital
actions.exact_action: “takes the tote goes there and operate there something like that.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If totes/packages cannot be addressed at the Hospital reject station as described, escalate for support (no additional troubleshooting steps are provided in the source beyond the reject-station concept).

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: “It takes the toad goes there and operate there something like that.”

steps.title: Verify packages are returned to the system for further processing
steps.purpose: Confirm the intended end state of the reject-station handling: packages associated with the addressed totes are back “on the system somewhere.”
steps.instruction: Confirm the intended outcome described in the segment: the packages “have to make it on the system somewhere” and the Hospital handling ensures packages “get back.”
steps.expected_result: Packages associated with the addressed totes are returned “back” to the system for further processing.
steps.healthy_condition: The workflow outcome matches the segment’s goal: packages get back onto the system after Hospital operator handling.
steps.failure_condition: Packages do not return to the system after Hospital handling.

actions.label: Confirm packages returned to system
actions.exact_action: Confirm the outcome that packages “get back” to the system after Hospital operator handling.

stop_or_escalate_if: If packages/totes do not return to the system after Hospital handling, escalate for support (source does not provide specific troubleshooting steps beyond the reject-station concept).

source_evidence.quote_or_evidence: “this package has to make it on the system somewhere… so that the packages get back.”

success_criteria: Totes/packages that did not get sorted due to a tipper issue are handled at the Hospital reject station by the operator.
Associated packages are returned “back” to the system for further processing.
healthy_conditions: The scenario matches the segment trigger: tipper issue + packages/totes did not get sorted.
Affected totes are at the Hospital reject station for operator handling.
After operator handling, packages are back on the system for further processing.
failure_conditions: Totes/packages cannot be addressed at the Hospital reject station as described.
Packages do not return to the system after Hospital handling.
escalation_guidance: If totes/packages cannot be addressed at the Hospital reject station as described, escalate for support. The source does not provide specific troubleshooting steps beyond the reject-station concept.
